callouts.text:
TODAY'S HIGH RETESTS
YESTERDAY'S CLOSE, THEN FADED

points: This screenshot only shows 77.90–78.25 — the last ~3 hours of a stock that closed at 78.24 yesterday after a huge breakout day. Everything below is real, but off this zoom.
Yesterday (13 Aug): gapped up from 74.21 to open 76.01, ran to 78.40, closed 78.24 — a 5.4% range on 1.4x average volume. That's the move behind today's elevated price.

The heaviest support isn't visible here: 73.00–74.50 is where NFLX spent the most time over the last month (time-at-price count 9-10 vs 2-3 up here). 76.29–76.90 is the next shelf down — yesterday's pre-breakout swing high, a natural first retest level if today's pullback continues.

Daily MACD is still solidly positive (0.80 vs signal 0.21) — the breakout thesis is intact on the timeframe that matters. The 1m MACD going negative just means the last few minutes cooled off, not that anything broke.
summary.bias: Read: healthy pullback inside a breakout, not a reversal — unless it gives back the gap
summary.invalidation: a daily close back below 74.50 would erase the breakout and put price back in the pre-breakout base; ATR14 is 2.30 (2.9%), so a 0.35 intraday dip like this one is unremarkable
